title: Spring 2027 Registration Windows Posted
body: Registration windows for Spring 2027 are now posted on the Student Portal. Seniors may register beginning next Monday, followed by juniors, sophomores, and first-year students in the following days.

title: New Waitlist Auto-Enroll Policy
body: Starting this semester, waitlisted students are automatically enrolled when a seat opens, instead of receiving only a notification. Check your Student Portal messages for confirmation before assuming you still need to act.

title: Add/Drop Deadline Reminder
body: The add/drop deadline for the current semester is this Friday at 11:59 PM. Courses dropped after this date will show a withdrawal grade on the transcript.

title: Prerequisite Override Requests Move Online
body: Prerequisite override requests must now be submitted through the Student Portal override form instead of paper forms at the department office.

title: Final Exam Schedule Published
body: The final exam schedule for this semester is now available on the Registrar's exam calendar page. Review your exam times before the conflict-reporting deadline.

title: Conflict Exam Request Deadline
body: Students with two exams scheduled at the same time must submit a conflict exam request by the date listed on the exam calendar to be rescheduled.

title: Accommodated Testing Room Assignments
body: Students approved for extended time or a reduced-distraction room should check the Office of Accessibility Services portal for their assigned testing room before exam week.

title: Exam Week Building Hours Extended
body: Library and study room hours are extended during exam week; see the Library's exam-week hours notice for the updated schedule.

title: Tuition Payment Deadline Approaching
body: Tuition payment for the upcoming semester is due in two weeks. Set up an installment plan now if you need to spread out payments.

title: Installment Plan Enrollment Fee Update
body: The enrollment fee for the four-installment tuition payment plan has been updated; see the Bursar's payment plan page for the current amount.

title: New Authorized Payer Feature Live
body: Students can now add a parent or sponsor as an authorized payer directly from the Student Portal billing tab.

title: Refund Schedule Posted for Withdrawals
body: The prorated refund schedule for students withdrawing from all classes this semester is now posted on the Bursar's refund policy page.

title: Next Semester Schedule Preview Available
body: A tentative preview of next semester's class schedule is now available on the Registrar's site ahead of the official registration window.

title: Room Changes Posted for Several Sections
body: Several course sections have updated room assignments due to building maintenance; check My Schedule for the latest room numbers.

title: New Printable Weekly Schedule Option
body: You can now generate a PDF of your weekly class schedule directly from the My Schedule page using the new Print Schedule button.

title: Linked Lab and Discussion Sections Reminder
body: Remember that courses with a linked lab or discussion section require registering for both the lecture and the linked section together.

title: Extended Counseling Hours This Month
body: Counseling and Psychological Services is offering extended evening hours this month to accommodate more student appointments.

title: Involvement Fair Date Announced
body: The fall Involvement Fair where student clubs recruit new members will be held in the Student Union Plaza; check the Student Life portal for the exact date.

title: Tutoring Sign-Ups Open for the Semester
body: Sign-ups for free peer tutoring through the Academic Success Center are now open for the current semester on the Student Portal.

title: ID Card Replacement Fee Waived for Stolen Cards
body: Card Services is temporarily waiving the replacement fee for students who file a police report for a stolen student ID card.

title: Graduation Application Deadline Reminder
body: The deadline to apply for graduation this term is next Friday. Submit your application through the Student Portal before the deadline.

title: Commencement Date Confirmed
body: The commencement ceremony date for this term has been confirmed; see the Commencement website for the schedule and guest ticket policy.

title: Cap and Gown Ordering Window Open
body: The campus bookstore's graduation portal is now open for ordering caps, gowns, and regalia for this term's commencement.

title: Honors Cutoff GPA Updated for This Term
body: The cumulative GPA cutoffs for Latin honors this term have been posted on the Registrar's honors policy page.

title: Scheduled Wi-Fi Maintenance This Weekend
body: Campus Wi-Fi, including HANU-Secure, will have brief outages this weekend during scheduled maintenance overnight.

title: New Self-Service Password Reset Tool
body: A new self-service password reset tool is now available on the Student Portal login page, reducing the need to contact the IT Help Desk directly.

title: VPN Client Update Required
body: Students connecting to the campus VPN from off campus must update to the latest VPN client version listed on the IT Services site.

title: Laptop Loan Program Extended Hours
body: The Library's laptop loan desk is extending its hours during the first two weeks of the semester to meet higher demand.
